title: W1_T1: Tutorial 1: Forward pass & backpropagation
description:
Welcome to Week 1 Tutorial 1 on the course "Generative AI" by Prof. Prathosh A P.
Full Course: https://study.iitm.ac.in/ds/course_pages/BSDA5002.html 

Video Overview
This tutorial provides a foundational understanding of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) and their role in supervised learning. We'll cover the basic MLP structure, delve into the forward pass with detailed calculations, and explore the concept of backpropagation using gradient descent to minimize error. This session assumes basic knowledge of MLPs and regression tasks.
